# ChestTracker

> ChestTracker is a Windows app for Fortnite Battle Royale that counts every chest you open or destroy, shows your real odds for every Treasure Hunters reward (Pirate Shop token, gold outfit, vehicle, pickaxe/back bling, Jam Track, loading screen, gizmo) and forecasts your next match. By CDRas. Not affiliated with Epic Games.

ChestTracker (also written "Chest Tracker" or "Fortnite Chest Tracker") is the Fortnite chest counter and treasure odds tracker for Treasure Hunters. It is not related to the Total Battle clan tool at chesttracker.com. In Italian: contatore di forzieri e probabilità dei tesori per Fortnite.

## What it does
- Counts every chest from the replay files Fortnite saves on your PC: normal, rare, sprite, buried; opened and destroyed.
- Exact probability for every reward, with Treasure Hour boosts and rewards you already own taken out.
- Next-match forecast (normal match and good match) and a luck check on gizmos.
- In-game overlay under the minimap, end-of-match card, squad chests, weekly rewards with pictures.
- Starts with Fortnite and closes with it. Light on memory and CPU.
- Safe: it only reads replay files. It never reads or changes the game, its memory or your Epic account.

## Facts
- Platform: Windows 10 / 11. Languages: English and Italian (follows Windows).
- Price: 4.99 EUR, one payment, no subscription. One licence key works on one PC at a time. Free updates.
- Chests are counted about 2 seconds after the match ends (Fortnite unlocks the replay only then); live counting during the match is not possible.
- Counted modes: Battle Royale Build and Zero Build, Solo, Duos, Trios, Squads.
